item.title: Abbeville Meridional and Kaplan Herald Sold to Kentucky-Based Paxton Media Group
item.description: The parish’s two longtime weeklies are among 14 Acadiana-area papers, plus a printing plant in Eunice, that Louisiana State Newspapers has sold to the family-owned chain from Paducah. The price was not disclosed.

item.title: Sheriff: Scammers Are Calling Families of People in the Parish Jail, Asking for Money to ‘Release’ Them
item.description: The callers know the inmate’s name and charge from public arrest records. The Sheriff’s Office says never send money before calling the jail yourself. Separately, deputies are looking for a man seen on video taking batteries and a weed eater from a business on LA 167.

item.title: Giant Omelette Weekend: Abbeville’s Celebration Runs Saturday and Sunday, With the Skillet Lit Sunday Afternoon
item.description: The Confrérie d’Abbeville’s festival fills downtown Nov. 7-8 with music, crafts, an antique car show and a tractor egg-cracking contest. The omelette itself is cooked only on Sunday, starting around 1:30 p.m.

item.title: Abbeville Woman, 69, Killed When Car Overturns on LA 86 Near New Iberia
item.description: She was a passenger and was thrown from the car early Tuesday, State Police said. She is the second Abbeville woman killed in a crash in four days, and troopers say neither was wearing a seat belt.

item.title: Vermilion Parish Election Results: Landry Wins DA Race, Broussard Wins Erath Mayor, Gueydan Heads to Runoff
item.description: Unofficial final returns: Don Landry is the 15th Judicial District’s next district attorney, Stephanie Broussard will lead Erath, and Gueydan picks its mayor in a Dec. 12 runoff. Both parish tax renewals passed.

item.title: Abbeville Woman, 28, Killed in Halloween Crash Near Duson; Rayne Driver Booked on Vehicular Homicide
item.description: State Police say a Buick failed to slow on LA 343 and hit the back of her car as she stopped for a stop sign. The other driver’s breath test came back over the legal limit, troopers said.

item.title: SpaceX Posts a Ninth Starbase Louisiana Job: A Second Communications Lead for Pecan Island
item.description: The new opening, posted Monday on SpaceX’s job board, is a second community-outreach role for the site. Like the first, it must work at Pecan Island full time.

item.title: Vote Early in the Day Tuesday: Storms Likely to Build by Afternoon and Evening in Vermilion Parish
item.description: The National Weather Service gives Abbeville a 50% chance of rain Tuesday, rising to 60% Tuesday night, with gusts up to 25 mph. Polls are open 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.

item.title: Nine Killed as Business Jet From Austin Crashes Into Palm Beach County Neighborhood
item.description: Updated Monday: The NTSB says there is evidence the Learjet began breaking up before it hit the ground, minutes after the crew reported ice and turbulence at 35,000 feet.

item.title: Vermilion Parish Early Vote Already Tops 2022 Midterm: 4,658 Ballots Cast Before Tuesday
item.description: State records show early in-person voting up about 20% over the last midterm. Polls open at 6 a.m. Tuesday and close at 8 p.m.; bring a photo ID.

item.title: Police Jury Approves RV Ordinance, Raises Ordinance Fines to $1,500 and Seeks a Vermilion Levee District
item.description: Draft minutes of the Oct. 21 meeting, posted on the parish website, show every vote was unanimous. A Gueydan drainage tax renewal is also headed to voters in April.

item.title: Old Paint, Oil and Batteries: Parish Sets Household Hazardous Waste Day for Dec. 12
item.description: Vermilion Parish residents can drop off chemicals, tires and recyclables for free at the parish solid waste plant, 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. Bring proof you live in the parish.

item.title: Council on Aging to Ask Police Jury for SpaceX-Related Money; Jurors Set Closed-Door Talk on Starbase Lawsuit
item.description: The Vermilion Parish Police Jury’s committees meet Wednesday, the day after the election. Here is everything on the agendas, taken from the parish’s own posted documents, and how to speak at the meeting.

item.title: School Board Orders Appraisal of 4,000 Acres Next to Starbase Louisiana Ahead of SpaceX Talks
item.description: The land near White Lake brings Vermilion Parish schools $20,000 to $30,000 a year in hunting leases. Superintendent Tommy Byler hopes a deal with SpaceX could mean better pay for teachers.

item.title: Iran Vows Retaliation ‘Without Geographic Limits’ as Trump Weighs New Strikes After Midterms
item.description: No new U.S. strike had been announced as of Saturday afternoon. Mediators are working in Qatar to restart talks, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio says the president has not decided.

item.title: Who Pays for LA 82? State Hires Landry Donor’s Firm for SpaceX Louisiana Road Work
item.description: The engineering firm DOTD chose for work around Starbase Louisiana has given $115,000 to a Landry-aligned PAC. The state still won’t say if the job was bid, what it costs, or who covers the road bill.

item.title: Where Is Starbase Louisiana? SpaceX’s Pecan Island Site, Explained
item.description: SpaceX’s planned launch site covers about 125,000 acres near Pecan Island in southern Vermilion Parish, roughly 27 miles from Kaplan and 30 from Abbeville as the crow flies.

item.title: SpaceX Louisiana Jobs: The First 8 Openings Posted for Pecan Island
item.description: SpaceX’s own job board lists eight positions at its planned Starbase Louisiana site, all senior engineering, construction, safety and community roles. Here is every one.

item.title: Week 9 Scoreboard: Kaplan Holds Off Abbeville, Erath and North Vermilion Roll
item.description: Final scores for every Vermilion Parish high school football team from Thursday and Friday night.

item.title: Starbase Louisiana: What Vermilion Parish Knows So Far
item.description: The jobs, the money, the timeline and the questions still open about SpaceX’s planned launch site near Pecan Island, in one place.

item.title: Citizen Group Presses for Answers on SpaceX Deal; Ex-Landry Aide Now a SpaceX Lobbyist
item.description: Vermilion United says the Starbase Louisiana tax agreement treats local hiring as a goal, not a promise, and wants a verbal SpaceX pledge on fire protection put in writing.

item.title: Kaplan Man Arrested on Drug and Firearm Charges After Search of Home
item.description: Investigators seized suspected methamphetamine, marijuana, prescription pills and two guns with an estimated street value of more than $68,000, KLFY reported.

item.title: Residents Sue to Void Parish’s SpaceX Tax Deal Over Open Meetings Law
item.description: A new citizens group and three residents say the Police Jury and a revived development board broke Louisiana’s Open Meetings Law eight times while approving the Starbase Louisiana agreement.

item.title: What’s on the Ballot in Vermilion Parish on Tuesday
item.description: Contested races for district attorney, mayor of Erath and Gueydan, two School Board seats and more are on the Nov. 3 ballot, along with 10 statewide constitutional amendments.
